description:
Fourth phase of bl-7c23. Make role -> soul + role -> model fully data-driven and remove the agents.yaml file/loader.

=== Scope ===

1. Per-repo providers.yaml 'roles:' section is now the single source of truth for role definitions. Phase 1 introduced the loader; this ball wires the dispatcher to use it for both model lookup AND soul lookup (souls/<role>.md by convention).
2. Remove src/config/agents.rs entirely (or empty to a doc-comment redirect). Update src/config/mod.rs and src/config/cross.rs to drop agents-related plumbing.
3. Remove agents.yaml from the embedded template (Phase 2 may have already done this — verify).
4. Per-repo providers.yaml loader (Phase 1) escalates from warn to error if it sees 'providers:' or 'models:' blocks (those belong to harness-root global providers.yaml only).
5. Soul write at dispatch (Phase 3) reads <conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md and copies it to the new branch's worktree root as soul.md on the dispatch commit. If souls/<role>.md is missing, hard error at dispatch.
6. Update src/config/schemas.rs: schemars-derived JSON schema for the per-repo providers.yaml is the new shape (roles only). Run the schema regeneration in this ball or defer to Phase 6 — claimer's call, but if schemas regenerate here, also update schemas/agents.json (delete) and schemas/providers.json (replace).

=== Constraints ===

- The 'role' string set is open: a workflow can dispatch any role name as long as souls/<role>.md and an entry in providers.yaml roles: exist for it. The harness does NOT hardcode 'worker'/'compactor' anywhere — they are conventions in the embedded template only.

=== Out of scope ===

- Compactor migration (Phase 5).
- Final schema regen sweep (Phase 6) unless the claimer rolls it in here.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: Phase 4: soul/role machinery + agents.yaml retirement
